cover.headline: Milan's new home gets a name.

deal.title: Generali names the new Milan stadium

rows.sub: 71,500-seat shared home for AC Milan and Inter
Official Insurance Partner of both clubs

why.title: Why this naming deal is different

points.sub: First match targeted for 2031/32, subject to approvals
Both sides of one of Europe's biggest rivalries

caption:
Milan's new home has a name before it has walls.

Generali has taken naming rights to the 71,500-seat stadium AC Milan and Inter plan to share, and becomes Official Insurance Partner of both clubs. The reported figure is about 650m euros, though the clubs haven't disclosed terms. First match is targeted for 2031/32, subject to approvals.

Also on the board: Carvana x Arizona Wildcats, TikTok x WTA, DHL x NHL, Perfect Bowl x Melbourne Storm and TNT Sports x Cricket Australia.
